name: 8am MyCase
description: 8am MyCase is cloud legal practice management software that keeps cases, clients, documents, calendaring, time and expenses, billing, payments, client communication, intake, workflows, and higher-tier legal AI in one firm workspace.
best_for: Solo lawyers and growing law firms that want case management, client communication, time tracking, billing, payments, document workflows, and optional embedded legal AI in one cloud platform.
features: Case and contact management with centralized case details, notes, tasks, events, documents, and contacts
Legal calendaring, time entry, expense tracking, billing, invoicing, and integrated payments
Secure client portal, messaging, texting, and client communication tools on applicable plans
Client intake forms, legal CRM, workflow automation, document generation, and unlimited eSignature on Pro
8am IQ Writing and Document Assistant on Pro and deeper Case/Discovery AI capabilities on Advanced
Advanced document automation, conflict-check tracking, split billing, desktop drive, and Open API on Advanced
70+ integrations on Pro and higher, according to current pricing materials

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: $120/user/month monthly. Adds workflows, intake/CRM, unlimited eSignature/document generation, richer communications, premium billing/reporting, 8am IQ writing/document tools, and 70+ integrations.

tiers.name: Advanced
tiers.notes: $150/user/month monthly. Adds 8am IQ Case and Discovery assistants, advanced document automation, desktop drive, conflict tracking, split billing, and Open API.

pros: Publishes exact monthly and annual per-user pricing for all three core plans
10-day free trial requires no credit card
Combines legal-specific casework, client communication, billing/payments, and higher-tier AI in one platform
cons: Client intake, eSignature, workflows, and several communication tools require Pro rather than Basic
Advanced AI, open API, conflict tracking, and advanced document automation require the highest Advanced tier

faq.question: How much does 8am MyCase cost?
faq.answer: Basic is $50/user/month billed annually or $60 monthly; Pro is $100 annually or $120 monthly; Advanced is $130 annually or $150 monthly.

faq.question: Does MyCase offer a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. MyCase offers a 10-day no-cost trial with full access and no credit card required.
